summary: Albin Chavy has joined Rosewood Hotel Group at its Hong Kong headquarters as Global Director, Operational Planning, covering planning for new and existing hotels. He spent more than seven years at Compass Group, latterly as Regional Director, Business Excellence, Asia Pacific.
title: Albin Chavy joins Rosewood as Global Director, Operational Planning
why: Rosewood keeps strengthening its central operating team in Hong Kong as its pipeline grows.
